description: This file contains generated C++ code for emulating GLSL built-in functions in HLSL, including function definitions for mathematical operations and matrix manipulations, as well as a lookup function for retrieving these emulated functions by unique ID.

classes.name: FunctionPair
classes.description: A structure pairing a unique function ID with its corresponding HLSL emulation code.

methods.name: FindHLSLFunction
methods.description: Retrieves the emulated HLSL function code corresponding to a given unique ID.
